scope: Independent arithmetic/identity diagnostic of four completed retained annual series. No engine rerun, no independent physical accuracy claim, no changed threshold or exclusion. Prior convergence remains failed.
source_location: %LOCALAPPDATA%/GreenLens/verification/v0.3 corrected annual candidate b0b46d98 空間/convergence
diagnostic_method: Verify every archive member SHA and nested run seal, decode little-endian time/sensor/RGB/lux records, verify RGB conversion, independently recompute all five metrics for all 24 sensors in four runs. Daily occupied intervals are 08:00 through 18:00 local standard time, HE9-18, including every day. DA includes 300 lx. Analyze every occupied threshold disagreement for s000023. No OS time conversions.
diagnostic_condition_policy: low_diffuse if DHI<50 Wh/m2; otherwise clear if DNI/DHI>=3, mixed if>=0.5, else overcast. Descriptive radiation grouping, not an independent sky classification.
direct_visibility_bound_method: For each emitted solar cap, independent component min/max bounds enclose all ray directions. Since facade is y=0, interval arithmetic bounds the aperture x/z intersection. A bound fully outside the rectangle proves no direct ray; possible intersection is not proof of illumination. Uses effective sensor z+1e-4 m. Also exclude a cap wholly above atan2(window_head - effective_sensor_z, facade_distance), the largest possible altitude to any point of the aperture; component ranges include +/- axis directions when inside the cap.

interpretation: All 480 stored metric values independently recompute exactly from retained lux samples, and all RGB-to-lux conversions agree exactly. Sensor IDs/order, time axis, weather and occupancy match across all four runs. No metric arithmetic/serialization error was found in these retained inputs.

The 83 occupied threshold disagreements are all shipping below 300 lx and reference at or above 300 lx. This is a real failed convergence result, not a count or denominator mismatch. The unchanged 2 percentage-point limit permits 73 net hourly classification differences at this occupancy; observed 83 exceeds it by 10.

DA is discontinuous at 300 lx; crossing hours contribute only about -0.04214 percentage points to cDA, while hours below threshold in both profiles contribute about -0.80645 points. This is consistent with broader small illuminance differences plus threshold crossings, not a DA/cDA implementation contradiction.

Every A crossing solar disc misses the window by an independently conservative aperture-direction bound. A has no overhang or surrounding obstruction. Thus the crossing differences cannot be attributed to the 1024-versus-4096 direct finite-disc quadrature at this sensor; diffuse/ground transport and/or reflected-solar/profile differences remain candidates.

The profiles jointly change sky basis MF2/MF4, bounce depth 8/9, full/direct coefficient sampling 131072/262144, and finite-disc samples. Retained combined arrays do not separate those components, so sampling alone cannot be established as the cause and the reference is not treated as ground truth.

Same-hour series alignment has substantially lower error than the inspected +/-1, +/-2 and +/-24 hour shifts. This supports correct paired indexing but is not an independent validation of the solar/time model.
No engine, matrix or light transport rerun was performed. All failed crossing samples and the original failed convergence check are retained; no tolerance, occupancy or sample was changed.
diagnostic_runtime: Python standard library used only for this independent retained-data analysis; not a GreenLens runtime requirement.
